newsitem.title: USA: AccuStaff Inc acquires CGS Services Inc.
newsitem.headline: AccuStaff Inc acquires CGS Services Inc.

text.p: AccuStaff Inc, a national provider of strategic staffing, consulting and outsourcing services, said on Friday it purchased CGS Services Inc.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

CGS provides commercial and office automation staffing services, specializing in the higher gross margin business with small to medium-sized companies. CGS will be part of AccuStaff's Commercial Division.
CGS's revenues for the fiscal year ended December 31 1996 were approximately $10 million, based on unaudited financial information.
